parameters.note: Overall width. Standard 400 / 450 (manufacturer data of BS EN 14073-2 certified office pedestals (e.g. Flexiform pedestal datasheet): 300 / 400 / 410 wide), unconfirmed for Dafna. D-17: Dafna's mobile pedestal 430 x 550 x 550 (founder's drawing, 2026-11-16). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Overall height incl. castors / plinth. ≈ 600 fits under a 740 mm desk (EN 527-1) with a 22–25 mm top (manufacturer data of BS EN 14073-2 certified office pedestals (e.g. Flexiform pedestal datasheet): 597). D-17: Dafna's mobile pedestal 430 x 550 x 550 (founder's drawing, 2026-11-16). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Overall depth incl. fronts. 500 (desk depth 600–700) / 600 (desk depth 800); unconfirmed. D-17: Dafna's mobile pedestal 430 x 550 x 550 (founder's drawing, 2026-11-16). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

3 equal drawers; 2 small drawers + 1 A4 hanging-file drawer (box >= 330 × 240, FILE_DRAWER_TOO_SMALL below); a door with one shelf. D-22 (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): no A4 hanging-file drawer - A4 files go into the document wardrobe, not a drawer (drawers2_file removed; the smallest drawer front is 120 mm, so 2 small drawers + a file drawer no longer fit 550 mm).
Mobile (castors) or standing on a plinth strip (sides to the floor).

backMaterial.note: HDF back and drawer bottoms (as the wardrobe).

castorHeightMm.note: Castor height incl. mounting plate (purchased part; unconfirmed). Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: depends on the hardware model - to come with the hardware list.

frontGapMm.note: Gap between the carcass front edge and the fronts (as the wardrobe doors). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

frontSideGapMm.note: Gap between a front and the outer side edge. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): fronts flush with the side panels

frontEdgeGapMm.note: Gap below the lowest front and under the top. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

drawerGapMm.note: Gap between drawer fronts (as the wardrobe).

fileFrontHeightMm.note: A4 hanging-file drawer front: box 260 high >= 240 (manufacturer data of BS EN 14073-2 certified office pedestals (e.g. Flexiform pedestal datasheet): file drawer ≈ 330 × 440 × 240). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

fileDrawerMinBoxWidthMm.note: A4 hanging-file frame needs >= 330 mm inside the box (manufacturer data of BS EN 14073-2 certified office pedestals (e.g. Flexiform pedestal datasheet)).

fileDrawerMinBoxHeightMm.note: A4 hanging files need >= 240 mm box height (manufacturer data of BS EN 14073-2 certified office pedestals (e.g. Flexiform pedestal datasheet)).

underDeskMaxHeightMm.note: An under-desk pedestal must stay below the desk top underside (740 − top − clearance); PEDESTAL_TOO_HIGH above.

drawerSlideClearanceMm.note: Side clearance per side for ball-bearing / roller slides (as the wardrobe). Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: depends on the hardware model - to come with the hardware list.

drawerBoxHeightReductionMm.note: Box height = front height − 40 (as the wardrobe). Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: depends on the hardware model - to come with the hardware list.

drawerBoxLiftMm.note: Box bottom above the front bottom edge. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): 10 mm

drawerBackClearanceMm.note: Space behind the drawer box. Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: depends on the hardware model - to come with the hardware list.

smallFrontMinHeightMm.note: Smallest drawer front (pens, stationery) in the 2 + file layout; the file drawer shrinks only below this. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): 120 mm

constructionRules.note: Top over the sides; bottom between the sides on the base; HDF back overlay; castors under the bottom corners, or sides to the floor with a plinth strip between them. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).
Fronts overlay the sides (full overlay), equal 3 mm gaps; drawer boxes on side slides.
